review.notes: Fence balance scan plus whole-document word/4-gram diff of the OCR Markdown against extracted text of all 11 physical PDF pages. The Figure 2 prompt-template boxes (physical p.6) exist in the PDF text layer but are dropped from the OCR text; the embedded Figure 2 image (inspected directly) fully shows both templates, so the text is figure-internal and not repaired. The abstract's 'WildCard (+4.3%)' matches the print's own spelling (WildGuard elsewhere) and was kept. Contributor lists (p.9), Conclusion, Table 1 and all reference entries were compared against the print; hyphenated line-break joins (Altenschmidt, development) are correct in the OCR.
